description: Reference render colours: how each kit colour appears in the 40 section images of the pinned instructions PDF (JPEG renders differ from catalog RGB). Used by classify.py with CIEDE2000; fixed so that extraction is deterministic (research R6, SC-008).
derivation: Derived once on 2026-11-21: the median 5x5 sample at each of the 10,240 cell centres was clustered by k-means in RGB (Euclidean), seeded with the tile icon colours sampled on page 159 (white #FFFFFF, #189090, #58A8C8, #A0C840, #C0B078, #58C040, #F08828, #F86088, #F8A828, #203868), iterated to convergence (3 iterations), and each centre rounded to integers. Not re-run at extraction time.
